chapter.verse: Israelte Izipt gam pan pusuakin, Jakob innkuanpihte paudang a zang mite kiang pan a paikhiat uh ciangin,
Judah gam in ama biakinn suak a, Israel gam in ama ukna gam a suak hi.
Tuipi in mu-in taikhia a, Jordan gun a nung kik hi.
Mualliante tuutal bangin diang uh a, mualneute tuuno bangin a diang uh hi.
Tuipi aw, na taikhiat nading, Jordan gun aw, na nungkik nading,
Mualliante aw, tuutal bangin, mualneute aw, tuuno bangin na dian’ nading uh bang in hong nasak ahi hiam?
Leitung aw, suangpi bualtui khuk suak sak a, meisuang pen ciktui a suak sak, Jakob Pasian’ omna, Topa ’ omna-ah kiliing in!
